jobs.description:
Who we are 
 

OTIV is a Ghent-based company leading the autonomous revolution in rail. We are on a mission to increase safety and efficiency of railway operations by teaching rail vehicles to drive autonomously. By making trains more efficient and safer, we actively contribute to a modal shift and a greener future. We bring this vision to life by a unique focus on the most challenging environments such as cities, shunting yards and industrial sites. Thanks to high-profile partners and world-leading clients such as Deutsche Bahn, SNCF Group, ArcelorMittal and CAF we deliver the future of railway operations today.
 

 
 

OTIV is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and in which personnel processes are merit-based and applied without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, or other protected characteristic. OTIV strives to create an environment in which all employees feel confident in their ability to bring their authentic selves to work and secure collaborating with colleagues and customers.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

Als 
Finance & Admin Specialist neem je ownership over de financiële administratie van OTIV: facturatie, procure-to-pay en ondersteuning bij onze maandelijkse, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen. Naast de cijfers breng je energie en structuur naar onze administratieve backbone: je houdt processen draaiende en mensen ondersteund. Je vormt een sterk team met Marthe (Admin Specialist met focus op People & Operations).
 

Ben jij iemand die detailgericht en samenwerkingsgericht is, onze bedrijfsprocessen met overtuiging wil opnemen, en zowel houdt van de nauwkeurigheid van finance als van de variatie die we te bieden hebben? Apply now!
 

 
 

Tasks and responsibilities
 

As Finance & Admin Specialist at OTIV you will
 

Finance (50%)
 
 

• Book incoming and outgoing invoices and ensure accurate processing 

• Manage the full PO-to-invoice flow 

• Support monthly, quarterly and annual closings together with the accountant 

• Assist in reporting actuals, budget and forecast, and follow up department and company budget 

• Handle payment processing, expenses and record-keeping 

• Administer company insurance matters  

Procurement & logistics
 
 

• Run the full procure-to-pay process: sourcing, receiving, invoicing 

• Place orders with suppliers and follow up to ensure on-time delivery 

• Take ownership of shipments (domestic and international) 

• Maintain accurate records in Odoo, including stock management  

Office & compliance
 
 

• Manage e-inboxes and handle incoming requests 

• Manage client site access, clearances and documentation 

• Administer office onboarding, car park, and PPE 

• Support ISO 9001 processes and audit documentation 

• Provide general administrative support and help coordinate events  

Furthermore, you will form a strong administrative team with Marthe (Admin Specialist with a focus on People & Operations).

Requirements
 
 

• Bachelor in accountancy or finance (or equivalent through experience) 

• 3+ years in a financial-administrative role 

• Confident with the numbers: closings, budget follow-up, procure-to-pay, invoicing 

• Hands-on with Odoo or comparable ERP and strong in Excel 

• Genuine passion for office management and general operations: you like keeping things running and people supported 

• Structured, accurate, and able to own end-to-end processes 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• Proactive and pragmatic, thrives in a fast-moving scale-up 

• Affinity with compliance and process improvement 

• Curious about AI and automation: you actively look for ways to streamline and automate administrative and finance processes  

• Fluent in Dutch & English (other languages are a plus)  

Nice to have:
 
 

• Previous experience in a fast-paced & broad administrative team, ideally in a tech or scale-up environment. 

• Experience in international shipping (export documentation,...) 

• Experience in People/HR processes (payroll, ...)

You will be accountable for the introduction and development of the FILOform & Wallmax product portfolio within Belgium. You will initiate and implement the local sales strategy securing a solid market share for your region.

• You will step up, maintain, expand and develop long-term relationships with new & existing clients in order to achieve and exceed sales targets.
• You will proactively identify and pursue business opportunities across diverse industries such as Telecom, Datacenters, Infrastructure and Energy. By ensuring a close interaction with your key stakeholders you keep abreast on upcoming projects and needs.
• You are able to translate your customer’s challenges into qualitative solutions, ensuring fulfillment of their business needs whilst pursuing customer satisfaction, through dedicated business partnering.
• You will keep abreast of market trends and data, related to the FILOform & Wallmax Product Portfolio and industries, to identify and determine market opportunities, increase the business market share and secure further market penetration.
• You will present business reports, sales reports and forecasts on a monthly basis.
• You will liaise with internal and external stakeholders across all sites, as appropriate.
• You will be updating the CRM tools (Salesforce, …).
• You will report directly to the Sales Manager BENE with who you will have close interactions and regular meetings.

• Bachelor or Master background combined with a senior technical sales experience with a proven track record and client portfolio within the Energy, Infrastructure, Data or Telecom sector. 
• Demonstrated history of achieving sales targets, growing revenue, analyzing and following-up on KPI’s.
• Able to quickly master and understand all technical aspects of the business and flexible towards new product introductions.
• Able to manage long and complex commercial- and product approval processes.
• Used to work in an innovative environment with a strong international and customer-oriented mindset.
• Reliable and valuable business partner assuring strong stakeholder management.
• Strong analytical skillset with the ability to effectively analyze market trends and customer needs.
• Experience in tender management is a plus.
• You are based in Belgium and are flexible to travel across the country to visit clients.
• Flexible to travel to The Netherlands and/or UK when required (limited).
• This role is a stand alone role that is mainly managed from a Home Office setting.
• You are fluent in English, Dutch and French.

What will you do as a Hooklift Truck Driver?
 

 
• Transport, collect and place roll-off containers at customer locations
 
• Secure containers with cover nets or tarps to ensure safe transport
 
• Alternate between driving and manual work on-site
 
• Respond to customer questions in a friendly and professional manner 

What are we looking for in a Driver C/CE with Hooklift Experience?
 

 
• Driving licence C or CE; only C but motivated to drive with a trailer? CE can be obtained internally
 
• Experience as a driver is an advantage but not required
 
• You are an early starter (between 4 a.m. and 6 a.m.)
 
• You speak Dutch, English or French for safety instructions

For our client, an international organization in Heverlee , we are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to lead the AP team. In this key role, you will ensure the accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments, maintain compliance with accounting and tax regulations and drive continuous process improvements.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead, coach, and develop the Accounts Payable team.

• Oversee the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.

• Coordinate invoice processing, payment runs, and AP-related financial controls.

• Manage monthly closing activities, reconciliations, accruals, and follow-up of outstanding items.

• Ensure compliance with VAT, tax, and internal accounting policies.

• Act as the main point of contact for AP-related matters across multiple stakeholders.

• Identify and implement process improvements, standardization initiatives, and automation opportunities.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent through experience.

• Several years of experience in Accounts Payable within a multinational or complex organization.

• Strong SAP knowledge; experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

• Solid understanding of VAT and accounting regulations.

• Proven experience leading and developing teams.

• Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• Interest in process optimization, automation, and digital finance solutions.

We are looking for Meat Production Workers for a growing food company!

The company processes ham and packages it for various supermarket chains.

The job is not physically demanding!

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

What are your responsibilities?

We are looking for an experienced auto body technician for a company specializing in cars.

What are your tasks?

- You repair and replace damaged bodywork and car parts on vehicles.

Friday: 8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.

What do we expect from you?

We are looking for an experienced seamstress/seamster for a mattress manufacturing company in the Maldegem region!

What will your tasks be?

As you gain more experience, we will teach you additional tasks step by step, such as:

What do we expect from you?

• You already have some experience with sewing or working on a sewing machine.
• You work precisely and are quality-oriented.
• You speak Dutch or English well!

About Fluves
 

Fluves is a pioneer in fiber optic sensing and subsea cable monitoring services. Through its Marlinks product line, Fluves delivers world-leading subsea cable integrity monitoring solutions to offshore wind operators worldwide by combining real-time data, advanced DTS & DAS technology, and smart analytics. Currently, Marlinks monitors over 1800km of power cables across the globe.
 

Your role
 

As Sales Manager at Fluves, you will be the commercial driver for the continued international growth of our Marlinks cable monitoring solutions. Your mission is to convert technical excellence into long-term customer relationships and revenue. You will work closely with our delivery, portfolio and development teams to bring the Marlinks product suite to the world’s leading offshore wind operators, utilities, and developers.
 

 
 

What you will do
 
 

• Own and drive the full sales cycle: from lead qualification and proposal development to contract negotiation and closing (for new and existing accounts) in the offshore wind sector. 

• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of international prospects across Europe, Americas, and Asia-Pacific, with a focus on developers, cable owners, operators, and EPC contractors. 

• Represent Fluves and the Marlinks product line at industry conferences and events (e.g. WindEurope, Global Offshore Wind, offshore energy summits), strengthening our brand and expanding our network. 

• Collaborate on the development and execution of territory plans, set ambitious sales targets, and report pipeline progress and market intelligence to the Head of Marketing & Sales Team. 

• Act as the voice of the customer internally, translating market feedback into product and service improvements in close collaboration with engineering and product teams. 

Who you are
 

You bring a combination of commercial drive, technical curiosity, and strong interpersonal skills. You:
 
 

• Have 5–10 years of B2B sales experience, ideally in offshore energy, cleantech, industrial monitoring, or related deep-tech sectors. 

• Are comfortable selling complex, technical solutions and can translate fiber optic monitoring into tangible business value for engineers, asset managers, and executives. 

• Are proactive, self-driven, and energized by building new markets from the ground up — you are a hunter and a builder. 

• Have strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to represent Fluves and the Marlinks product line confidently at senior levels and major international events. 

• Are willing to travel internationally (10-15%), to key markets in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Americas. 

• Are fluent in English. Additional languages are a strong asset.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager & Technical Support Engineer Textile Division
jobs.description:
Product Manager & Technical Support Engineer Textile Division

We are looking for a Product Manager & Technical Support Engineer for our Textile Division (EMEA). In this hybrid role, you combine strategic product management with hands-on technical support. You act as a key link between customers, Sales, R&D, and Operations, ensuring our products meet market needs and perform optimally in real-life applications.
 

Your responsibilities

 

• Manage and develop the product portfolio throughout its full lifecycle (from concept to phase-out) in close collaboration with R&D
• Translate market needs and customer feedback into product requirements and development priorities
• Define product positioning, value propositions, and technical differentiators
• Coordinate product launches, updates, and discontinuations across departments
• Monitor product performance, competitiveness, and profitability
• Provide technical expertise and training to internal stakeholders
 

Technical & Application Support:

• Deliver on-site and remote technical support (machine trials, testing, troubleshooting)
• Support customers during industrial trials and start-ups
• Analyze technical issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions
• Prepare and maintain technical documentation and reports
• Act as escalation point for complex technical issues
 

Collaboration:

• Act as technical interface between customers and internal teams
• Collect and structure customer feedback for continuous improvement
• Support Sales during customer meetings and project discussions
• Participate in customer visits, exhibitions, and industry events

Who are you?

 

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Textile Technology, or a related field
• You have experience in product management, technical support, or application engineering within an industrial environment
• You are analytical, hands-on, and solution-oriented
• You combine strategic thinking with a practical, customer-focused approach
• You communicate clearly with both technical and commercial stakeholders
• You enjoy working in an international environment and are willing to travel regularly within EMEA
• You are fluent in English (additional European languages are a plus)

We are looking for a glass installer for a leading window and door company in Anzegem. In this role, you will assemble high-quality, durable custom-made aluminum and PVC products.

• You have a technical education or relevant experience in construction
• You work with precision and have a sharp eye for detail
• You think logically to solve problems during installation

• You can work independently and make your own decisions
• You speak fluent Dutch or English

• You install various types of glass panels into aluminum windows and doors
• You inspect the quality of the products before they are shipped
• You report directly to the aluminum production manager

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

For our client, we are looking for a motivated car body technician who enjoys working with vehicles and is not afraid to get hands-on.

You will join an experienced team in a car body repair company specialized in accident damage repairs.
What will you do?
• Disassemble vehicle body parts 
• Reassemble car components after repairs 
• Work on vehicles damaged in accidents 
• Use basic tools (screws, bolts, removing and reattaching parts) 
What do we expect from you?
• Experience with cars or bodywork is an advantage 
• Strong work ethic and motivation to work 
• Careful and precise approach to tasks 
• A team player with a humble attitude Languages
• No knowledge of Dutch required 
• Basic English is sufficient for communication 
• The team already includes international workers (including Polish and Albanian colleagues)

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As an operator, you will be responsible for 1 of 2 automatic packaging lines.

 
• 
You carry out checks on the food products that are introduced.

 
• 
You also set various parameters so that the right product ends up in the right packaging.

 
• 
Furthermore, you have to monitor the smooth operation of your packaging line.

 
• 
In case of technical failures, you are the first person who tries to solve this. For major malfunctions, you coordinate with the person in charge.

 
• 
The checks on the finished product are also done by you.

 
• 
All this in a team with a co-operator and 2 forklift drivers.

Read on quickly below and find out if you qualify:

 
• 
You have experience in setting up machines (it is a vertical packaging machine).

 
• 
You have a good technical knowledge.

 
• 
You speak good English and Dutch

 
• 
Experience as a forklift operator or forklift certificate is a plus.

 
• 
You highly value safety.

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a 
Mechanical Design Engineer – Robotics and help shape compact, high-performance actuators for robotics. You’ll translate demanding motion requirements into practical, manufacturable mechanical designs. 
 

This is what you’ll do: 
 
 

•  

Design and develop mechanical solutions for robotic systems, from concept through prototype and production. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T. 
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification to ensure performance, reliability, and durability. 
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications. 
   
 

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous design improvement. 
  

Who are we looking for? 
 
 

•  

Master’s degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in the design and development of robotic systems, actuators, or precision motion systems. 
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools. 
   
 

•  

Strong understanding of robotics system requirements and performance specifications, with the ability to translate payload, speed, torque, force, power, accuracy and duty cycle into mechanical design requirements. 
   
 

•  

Strong awareness of the latest trends and technologies in robotics, with a good understanding of emerging robotic architectures, actuation technologies, and motion solutions. 
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium. 
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.
